title: ZEBRONICS SILENCIO 111, Wireless Headphone, Hybrid ANC (50dB), 55*Hrs Backup, Transparency Mode, 40mm Titanium Drivers, 3 EQ Modes, ENC, Gaming Mode, Dual Pairing, Rapid Charge, Bluetooth v5.4 (Black)
bullets: ERGONOMIC DESIGN: Enjoy all-day comfort with lightweight headphones, designed with soft, durable earcups for extended listening sessions.
CONNECTIVITY: Features BT v5.4 and AUX for seamless connectivity and supports dual pairing with two devices simultaneously.
HYBRID ANC: Block out distractions with powerful 50dB Hybrid ANC for an immersive audio experience.
TRANSPARENCY MODE: Hear surroundings clearly without removing headphones, thanks to smart and seamless transparency mode.
CALLING FUNCTION: Stay connected effortlessly with built-in calling, featuring ENC technology to reduce background noise for clear calls.
INCREDIBLE AUDIO: Enjoy crystal-clear sound with 40mm titanium drivers delivering pristine acoustics and powerful bass.
LOW LATENCY GAMING: Experience high-speed gaming with wireless headphones designed for low latency performance.
VOICE ASSISTANT SUPPORT: Voice assistant feature allows convenient control of audio playback, calls, and alarms.
